name: Parallax Push
description: The camera tracks sideways past a dark, out-of-focus pillar standing close to the lens: the pillar rushes across the frame while the clips far behind it drift slowly the same way with a slight push in, and the cut to the second clip happens hidden behind it. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction in which everything moves, snapped to its main axis (x right, y up)

params.name: parallax
params.description: How far each clip drifts behind the pillar, as a part of the frame

params.name: width
params.description: Width of the pillar, as a part of the shorter side of the frame

params.name: blur
params.description: How out of focus the pillar is, and how much it blurs as it rushes past

params.name: pillar
params.description: Color of the pillar, lit from the side it moves toward
